summary: Re-ran tools/composition/matrix-probe.mjs to its documented default path on an uncontended RunPod box. The canonical artifact now reads ran:true, 12 demonstrated seam crossings, 3 structural, score 36, BOTH HARD FAILS CLEAR, all four W1 floors met — reproducing the 2026-08-11 side artifact cell for cell. The two artifacts were never in disagreement: the old canonical was a contention REFUSAL with zero probes executed, and the side artifact was a real run of a LATER instrument (15 cells vs 10, alert observable moved to a different accessor). Proved the instrument can go red two ways, found and fixed a blind spot in its self-test, and built a census of the stale-canonical pattern across the whole population.
next_step: None for this task. Two handoffs left for W1-25's owner, both in section 4 and 5 of the report: the five BOS->* cells compute `support` from the wrong quantity, and reports/experience/w1/pbrule-audit.json is the same stale-canonical shape a second time in the same piece.
notes: Ran in an isolated git worktree, so nothing here could collide with the dozen agents in the shared tree. tools/composition/matrix-probe.mjs is W1-25's file and was last authored by the W1-25 persistent builder on 08-11; the edits here are additive (a --null-control flag and two self-test fixes) and change no probe and no observable.

CONTENTION: tools/contention.mjs on this box read 5 browser instances and load 5.34 per core against a 4.0 ceiling — over the ceiling, exit 3 — for the whole session. That is the same condition that produced the 2026-08-08 refusal record in the first place. So NO local browser was launched at any point. The measurement went to a RunPod Pod, where the same tool read 0 instances and 0.07 per core and said GO, and the probe's own contention gate passed on its merits rather than being forced with --force.

The Pod was used as an UNCONTENDED BOX, not for its GPU. Every probe calls setRenderRate(0) and reads simulation state, never pixels. NVIDIA RTX A5000, SECURE, $0.270/hr, run 20260814-102825Z-14955, three arms in one provisioning.

FIRST POD ATTEMPT FAILED and is recorded rather than tidied away: --include corpus made a 782 MiB snapshot and the upload died at 56 MiB with HTTP 404 from the Pod proxy. The fix was --only-path game --only-path tools --only-path package.json --only-path corpus/95-experience, a 174 MiB snapshot, which went through first time. corpus/70-visual alone is 706 MB; a future agent needing corpus on a Pod should name the subdirectory.

NO SCREENSHOT IS OFFERED and none would be honest. Every claim in this round is a verdict count or a state read; the probes disable rendering. Rule 27's picture is genuinely not applicable here, so it is reported as not done rather than manufactured.

The census's own first live run flagged THIS ROUND'S canonical measurement as BEHIND_SIDE, against the two --null-control artifacts I had just written — they share the schema and are newer. A control is not a competing measurement. Narrowed by field (isMeasurement() rejects null_control and ran:false), not by path; special-casing the filename would have made the census pass on exactly the tree it was written against.
done: THE ANSWER. reports/composition/w1/matrix.json now records a real run: ran:true, 12 demonstrated live cells (floor 10), 12 demonstrated seam crossings (floor 4) split 5 W->F / 7 F->W, 3 structural (floor 1), matrix score 36 (floor 20). hard_fail_1_fewer_than_4_crossings false, hard_fail_2_zero_f2w false, all four floor_met true. Written 2026-08-14T10:32:21Z at commit f680d662, stamped with commit and host.

IT REPRODUCES THE 08-11 SIDE ARTIFACT CELL FOR CELL. Same 12 OK, same 3 INERT (SPL->ROS, EQP->ROS, DIS->BOS), three days and many commits later on different hardware. W1-25-DIVERGENCE's reversible ruling stands and its named falsifier — a re-run that does not reproduce 12 — did not fire.

THE TWO ARTIFACTS WERE NEVER IN DISAGREEMENT, AND THIS IS THE MORE USEFUL FINDING. The old canonical recorded ran:false, why:'tools/contention.mjs --gate refused; no browser was launched', results:[] — ZERO PROBES EXECUTED. Its zeros are RI-CMP01 hard fail 5 (unmeasurable => 0, fail-closed) applied to a run that never happened, which the tool writes deliberately so a stale file cannot be read as this commit's answer. The side artifact was a real run of a LATER instrument: commit a8e53de2 (08-11) grew the probe table from 10 cells to 15 and moved the alert observable off listEntities() (no alert_state) onto getEncounterState().members[] (has it). Three artifacts, three different things, all honestly produced.

THE INSTRUMENT GOES RED ON PURPOSE, ARM 1 — A WHOLE-RUN NULL CONTROL. Added --null-control on|off to matrix-probe.mjs. It changes exactly one line: both arms get the same `set`, so the source-state fork is gone; browser, seed 1234, per-arm loadState, encounters, observables and roll-up are identical. Real run 12 demonstrated / 3 paper / 0 vacuous. Null control 'on': 0 demonstrated, 15 paper, 0 VACUOUS. Null control 'off': 0 demonstrated, 15 paper, 0 VACUOUS. Effect size 12 against 0 over the same 15 probes.

THE NULL CONTROL IS THE PLAUSIBLE WRONG ANSWER, NOT THE TRIVIAL ONE. Zero vacuous cells in both controls is the load-bearing detail: the world stayed fully populated and support was preserved (ROS->DIS still ranged over 392 NPCs, SCH->ROS over 56, TOD->ROS over 4/2). The cells went INERT because the fork was removed and for no other reason. An empty world would have collapsed every observable by accident — the mistake that let a landform instrument report 71% coverage of a world containing none of the thing it measured. The flag also refuses to write the canonical default path and stamps null_control into its own artifact.

THE INSTRUMENT GOES RED ON PURPOSE, ARM 2 — AND THE SELF-TEST HAD A BLIND SPOT EXACTLY WHERE IT HAD BEEN WRONG BEFORE. Three sabotages on a copy. A: a probe's fork made a no-op -> old self-test FAIL, correct. B: alertValue reads x.alert, a field the members array does not carry -> old self-test PASS 15/15. C: alertArena reads listEntities(), THE 2026-08-10 DEFECT VERBATIM -> old self-test PASS 15/15. So the exact defect that produced the 08-10 all-paper result was invisible to the check meant to catch it.

TWO CAUSES, BOTH FIXED. (1) The self-test never ran ALERT_HELPER: a comment beside it claimed it exposed 'the same two page-side helpers the live path injects' while the code hand-wrote two lookalikes, so the file's most defect-prone code was the one part of the probe body no self-test exercised. It now evaluates ALERT_HELPER itself through the same new Function construction the live path uses. (2) The fake world was MORE PERMISSIVE THAN THE REAL ONE: Engine.listEntities() at game/src/engine.js:10612 returns {eid,kind,archetype,pos,hp} and carries no alert_state, while the fake handed back the whole entity. The fake now projects to the real accessor's field set. After both: sabotage B FAIL 1 cell, sabotage C FAIL 4 cells, intact still PASS 15/15.

WHICH FIX CARRIES THE EFFECT (RULES #6) — A DEPENDENT PAIR, NOT TWO GUARDS FOR ONE DEFECT, AND SAID SO. Fix 1 alone leaves sabotage C invisible (PASS 15/15). Fix 2 alone turns the INTACT self-test red (FAIL 4/15), because the hand-written helper reads alert_state off the now-faithful accessor. Only both together give intact PASS 15/15 and sabotage C FAIL 4/15.

WHAT IS THIN ABOUT THE 12, REPORTED RATHER THAN ROUNDED UP. BOS->DIS moves ONE disposition in 392 (gallery-intake-keepers -5 -> 35) against a declared mechanism of 'province-wide reaction'. Arms differ and support is intact so the cell is legitimately OK under the tool's rule, but one group in 392 does not evidence province-wide. Struck out entirely the run still reads 11 live cells, 11 crossings, 3 structural, score 34 — every floor still met and both hard fails still clear, so the verdict is robust to it.

A NARROW INSTRUMENT GAP LEFT FOR THE PIECE'S BUILDER. The five BOS->* cells compute support as H.questBook().includes('Q-MAIN-28') ? 1 : 0 — whether the quest exists — while the tool's own doc defines support as 'how many units the observation ranged over'. It understates rather than overstates, but it disconnects the vacuity guard from the observable for those five: a BOS->DIS over an empty disposition map could not report VACUOUS. Not repaired here, because repairing a probe is a builder's judgement about what the cell asserts and this round is a re-measurement.

NINE OF THE TWELVE CROSSINGS REST ON SUPPORT <= 2. The broad ones are SCH->ROS (56 NPCs, 41 of them in different places at hour 2 vs 13), ROS->DIS (392 NPCs) and TOD->ROS (4). Under the owner's Ruling W1, a crossing demonstrated over one entity shows the seam exists, not that a player will meet it.

THE STALE-CANONICAL PATTERN NOW HAS AN INSTRUMENT AND A POPULATION. New tool tools/composition/stale-canonical-census.mjs. POPULATION SEARCHED, STATED: every tool under tools/**/*.mjs naming a DEFAULT output path — 16 tools; 6 more take --out with no default and cannot rot this way, listed separately because that is the better design. The test is RULES #12's question — has the code that produces this artifact been committed since it was written — with bank commits excluded via --invert-grep --grep=Orchestrator-Bank, or every tool would date to today.

ELEVEN OF SIXTEEN CANONICAL PATHS ARE STALE. Over the shared tree (which holds the untracked artifacts a worktree checkout does not): REFUSAL 1, BEHIND_SIDE 1, STALE_VS_TOOL 9, ABSENT 2, FRESH 3. The BEHIND_SIDE is reports/experience/w1/pbrule-audit.json, whose newer same-schema twin sits at reports/experience/w1-25-persistent-builder/pbrule-current-wave.json — THE SAME SHAPE A SECOND TIME, IN THE SAME PIECE. The nine STALE_VS_TOOL span souls (5), experience (3) and world (1), and include event-histogram.json, one of the two the W1-25 agent named by hand as still fed by the dead 79 MiB exp-w1-opening trace.

EIGHT OF THE SIXTEEN CANONICAL PATHS ARE UNTRACKED, covered by reports/.gitignore's `*`. That is a deliberate decision about size, not a defect, and the census reports it without failing on it — but it means those canonical paths exist only on the container that made them and a fresh clone reads nothing there.

WHAT THE CENSUS PROVABLY CANNOT SEE, SAID PLAINLY. reports/experience/w1/anecdote-trace.json comes back FRESH and IS nonetheless fed by the dead trace, because its tool has not been committed since either. The tool-commit test catches 'the instrument moved and the artifact did not'; it does not catch 'the world moved and the artifact did not'. The honest fix is input identity, not timestamps, and that is written into the ruling's falsifier.

THE CENSUS CAN GO RED. --self-test runs 13 fixtures with no git and no disk, and the negative arm is a plausible healthy tree — real schemas, real siblings that are older, tool commits that genuinely predate their artifacts — not an empty one. Sabotaged on a copy: disabling the refusal check gives FAIL and exit 5.

RULING W1-25-C (REVERSIBLE), ruled rather than asked per CLAUDE.md rule 0. (1) A tool's default --out is the canonical path and re-running to it is part of finishing a round. (2) Never coin a second instrument name for one schema — matrix-live.json beside matrix.json is what hid this for six days; round records go to reports/<piece>/<round>/<same-leaf-name>.json. (3) Every artifact stamps commit and host; matrix-probe.mjs now does, with a RUNPOD_SOURCE_REVISION fallback for workers with no .git. (4) An artifact that is not a measurement of the shipped tree says so in a field — ran:false and null_control are the two that exist. (5) The tripwire is stale-canonical-census.mjs, exit 2. REVERSAL: one step, none of it read by the game — delete the census tool and revert the --null-control flag and the two self-test fixes. FALSIFIER: if re-running the nine STALE_VS_TOOL artifacts reproduces their numbers, the tool-commit test is noise and the right test is input identity, which would also catch anecdote-trace.json.
could_not_do: Did not file a W1-25 verdict, and this round is not one. It re-measures one instrument on one path and rules on one pattern. The critic-owned population under the plan's sections 3.C/3.D — matched >=90-minute A/B sessions, the isolated 500-word baton chain, the blind pair, the complete permissiveness population — is still unrun, and RI-EXP02's verified_anecdotes_per_hour is still UNMEASURED rather than measured-and-zero.

Did not repair the five BOS->* cells' support computation. Repairing a probe is a builder's judgement about what its cell asserts, and rule 23 forbids a judge becoming the builder of the thing it judged. Left as a minimal, located handoff in section 4 of the report.

Did not re-run the eleven stale canonical artifacts the census found. Nine of them belong to souls, experience and world pieces with their own owners, and each needs the piece's own context to know whether a re-run is cheap or needs a browser. The census names them, exits 2, and is the thing that will keep naming them.
Did not offer a screenshot. Every claim here is a verdict count or a state read and the probes disable rendering, so any picture would be decoration presented as evidence.

Did not touch reports/experience/w1/*.json or the dead exp-w1-opening trace. They are untracked, live only in the shared tree, and belong to pieces with live agents; reading them for the census is safe, rewriting them from a worktree is not.

Did not run tools/boot-check.mjs on this tree. The Pod run is stronger evidence for this purpose — the game loaded, the harness came up, 15 probes drove it and page_errors came back empty — but that is a statement about the snapshot commit f680d662 plus my tools/ edits, not a general boot claim.
